spec.file: 灵犀平台自然语言智能控制功能设计规范V1.4.docx
spec.read_mode: read-only text extraction, original file untouched

tests.denominator_note: unified for all V1.4 docs and evidence at closeout; phase-local totals are not used as denominators

simulator_verified: six AI lifecycle stages recorded separately; only started feeds active_algorithms
global/annotation dedupe; shared algorithm not stopped when one annotation leaves
duplicate entered/left idempotent (no revision bump); stale sequence and stale annotation_version rejected
body annotation AI binding rejected; unconfigured algorithm never runs
mapping preview warns and changes nothing; confirm runs six atomic steps in order
mapping invalidation makes route_resume / continue_from_breakpoint fail permanently
temporary task replacement keeps main breakpoint; old completion event rejected
low battery return has top priority; recharge restores only a still-valid inspection mainline
end_all clears breakpoint; post-temporary choice is explicit (no default)
fake_java_http_verified: KtdPlatformExecutor calls the atomic gateway before any transport submit
unavailable gateway => MAPPING_INTERRUPTION_UNAVAILABLE with zero transport calls
ai_algorithm_set on platform => ALGORITHM_LIFECYCLE_UNAVAILABLE with zero transport calls
mapping preview returns a confirmation card with the invalidation warning instead of a silent reject
real_platform_missing: no algorithm-level start/stop interface found; only task-level AI switch exists
no atomic 'stop stitching + void rebuild/break info + disable resume' endpoint
no annotation AI configuration read API (default gateway raises ANNOTATION_ALGORITHM_SOURCE_UNAVAILABLE)
no event source contract for annotation enter/leave delivery
real_ai_receipt_missing: no real algorithm run receipt; simulator receipts are labelled execution_mode=simulator
real_mapping_db_transaction_unverified: six-step atomicity is only simulated in memory; no database transaction, no rollback proof

resources.network: no socket connections (offline guard), no MQTT, no drone, no shared test/uat/prod service
resources.writes: no platform write operations, no deployment, no shared service restart
resources.secrets: no credentials, tokens, cookies, private keys or raw logs recorded
